blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.
blocks.zh: 解决多式联运任务需要Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)对图像和问题文本形成统一的理解. 然而,根据目前的自愿终止措施的因果关注,一个符号只能处理它之前的事情。 因此,无论哪一种方式最先出现,都是在部分观察输入的情况下编码的,其他多式联运上下文对此不知情。 我们引入了“二次视觉提示”(SLP),这是一种在输入中重复图像问题对的无训练方法。 在重复的拷贝中,每个视觉和文字符号都可以关注完整的输入,产生一个对对的统一的多式联运编码. 此外,新增的视觉符号除了重新曝光图像之外,还有助于计算:即使是空白图像在它们的位置上也能改进推理. 在12个基准中,SLP改进了每个被评价模型的总平均分,跨越9个开源模型(3B-72B)和3个专有前沿模型,在MATH-Vision上双子座3 Flash的得分达到5.6分. 我们的分析揭示了两个互补的机制:第二个图像所在的问题指南,以及添加的视觉符号充当一个预填抓图,其隐藏状态保留了图像和问题中与答案有关的信息。 这些结论强调,投入列报是改进自愿和半自动交易性能的简单而有效的方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Gemma Team et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) answer questions about images by encoding the image and the question as a single causal token sequence. Prior work improves their reasoning through generation-time strategies ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) ; we instead ask how the input presentation shapes representations during prefill. Under causal attention, a single-pass presentation in either order allows only one-way cross-modal interaction: the earlier modality cannot attend to the later one. In the standard image-before-question prompt, denoted ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle , visual tokens therefore cannot attend to the question. Here, 𝒱 {\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}} denotes the image block and 𝒯 {\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}} the complete question text, including instructions and options. We refer to this constraint as the cross-modal partial-observation problem .

blocks.en: We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free presentation establishing unified multimodal encoding within a causal backbone: append the same image and question to the standard prompt, forming ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 , 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle . During prefill, the second image attends to both the initial image and the question, yielding a question-guided second look; the repeated question then conditions on this updated visual state alongside the full preceding context. SLP requires no parameter updates, added task information, or model-internal access.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了“第二视觉提示”(SLP),这是在因果主干范围内建立统一多模式编码的免费培训演示文稿:将相同的图像和问题附加到标准提示符上,形成\\ V, T, V, T\ langle\ mathcal\ xcolor[rgb]{0, 0, 1} V\\\\ xcolor[rgb]{1, 0, 0, 0} T\\, \ mathcal\ xcolor[rgb]{0, 1} V\ mathcal\ xcolor[rgb]{1, 0.5, 0} T\rangle 。 在预填时,第二个图像既涉及初始图像,也涉及问题,产生一个问题引导的第二次外观;再重复一个问题,然后将这一更新的视觉状态与之前的全部上下文附加条件。 SLP不需要参数更新,添加任务信息,或模型-内部访问.

blocks.en: Across 12 reasoning and perception benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average of all 12 models: nine open-source models from 3B to 72B and three proprietary frontier models. Overall gains reach up to 1.7 points (Figure 1 , middle; Table 1 ) and are larger on reasoning tasks on average. Measured end-to-end latency on the nine open-source models changes by at most ± 0.16 \pm 0.16 seconds on family average (Section 3.5 ). A continued-training study also shows that the model can learn to better use the second look: with matched training data and steps, LLaVA-OneVision-7B-SI gains 1.97 points under SLP versus 0.55 under the standard prompt (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在整个12个推理和感知基准中,SLP提高了所有12个模型的总平均值:9个开源模型从3B到72B以及3个专有前沿模型. 总体收益高达1.7分(图1,中;表1),平均推理任务增加。 9个开源模型上测量的端到端间歇性变化,在家庭平均值上最多为±0.16\pm0.16秒(第3.5节). 一项持续培训研究还显示,该模型可以学会更好地利用第二种外观:通过匹配的培训数据和步骤,LLaVA-One Vision-7B-SI在SLP下得分1.97分,在标准速率下得分0.55分(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: Three controlled studies examine how the second look supports answering. First, the question actively guides the second look. Once it can attend to the question, the second image directs cross-image attention toward question-relevant regions (Section 3.3.1 ). Second, added visual tokens can act as a prefill scratchpad. Their hidden states retain information from the image and question that the model can later use to answer, giving the second look a computational role beyond revisiting the image. For models that effectively write information into a blank second image, placing one between the repeated questions improves reasoning over text-only replay and can even outperform full-image replay (Figure 1 , right; Section 3.3.2 ). Third, reasoning does not resolve cross-modal partial observation. Generated text cannot reorganize visual states formed during prefill; empirically, SLP gains remain similar under direct-answer and default prompts, while text-only repetition gains shrink (Section 3.3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 三项受控研究研究了第二次外观如何支持回答. 第一,这个问题积极指导第二面观。 第二幅图像一旦能够处理该问题,就会把跨图像的注意力引向与问题有关的区域(第3.3.1节)。 其次,添加的视觉符号可以起到预填刮纸的作用. 他们隐藏的状态保留了图像中的信息,并质疑模型日后可以用来回答的问题,给第二次外观一个除了重温图像外的计算作用. 对于有效将信息写入空白的第二图像的模型,在重复的问题之间放置一个,比仅文本的重播改善了推理,甚至可以超越全图像重播(图1,右;第3.3.2节). 第三,推理不能解决跨模式部分观察问题。 生成的文本不能重组在预填时形成的可视状态;经验中,SLP增益在直接回答和默认提示下仍然相似,而文本只重复增益则缩小(第3.3.3节).

blocks.en: Together, these results show that input presentation alone can shape prefill representations and improve VLM performance. This complements work on generation-time reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2024 ) and input order ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Wardle and Sušnjak, 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . We will release our code.
blocks.zh: 这些结果加在一起表明,仅投入呈现就可以塑造预填表示,提高VLM性能. 这补充了关于代时推理(张等,2024年;周等,2024年;曹等,2024年)和输入顺序(谭等,2024年;沃德勒和苏什尼亚克,2025年;魏等,2026年)的工作. 我们将发布我们的代码。

blocks.en: 2 From Causal Attention to Second-Look Prompting
blocks.zh: 2 从因果注意到二眼提示

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows how input presentation shapes cross-modal attention under a causal mask. In the standard prompt ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle , visual tokens precede the question, so their hidden states are computed under partial observation of the input and are never revised. Later generated tokens can read both modalities but only add text states; they cannot produce a question-conditioned visual representation. Creating one requires visual tokens that follow the question, which only the input can provide.

blocks.en: Unified multimodal encoding via SLP. Second-Look Prompting repeats both modalities: ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ ⟶ ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 , 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ ≔ ⟨ 𝒱 1 , 𝒯 1 , 𝒱 2 , 𝒯 2 ⟩ . \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle{}\quad\longrightarrow\quad\langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle{}\coloneqq\langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}}_{1},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}_{1},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}}_{2},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}_{2}\rangle. By resolving the partial-observation constraint, 𝒱 2 {\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}}_{2} can selectively integrate visual and textual context during prefill. We call 𝒱 2 {\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}}_{2} a multimodal prefill scratchpad . Appending 𝒯 2 {\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}_{2} then provides text token positions that read this scratchpad together with the full prompt history (step 2) without disturbing the familiar ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle prefix. In the repeated copy, each modality is thus encoded with the other in context. We examine how this scratchpad retrieves information under question guidance in Section 3.3.1 (Finding 1) and evaluate what it retains and computes in Section 3.3.2 (Finding 2).

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate SLP on a diverse set of VLM families, covering Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) at four scales (3B, 7B, 32B, and 72B), Gemma-3-IT ( Gemma Team et al., 2025 ) at three scales (4B, 12B, and 27B), and MiniCPM-V 4.5 (8B) and MiniCPM-o 4.5 (9B) ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) , jointly abbreviated as MiniCPM-V/o 4.5. All open-source models are the official instruction-tuned checkpoints. We also include three proprietary models: GPT-5.4 mini, Gemini 3 Flash, and Claude Haiku 4.5.

MathVista is evaluated on its testmini split and the other benchmarks on their standard evaluation splits; due to inference cost, each proprietary model is evaluated on up to 1,000 samples per benchmark.

blocks.en: SLP improves open-source VLMs across families and scales. blocks.en: Content-free blocks enable answering. Remarkably, ℛ {\mathcal{R}} need not contain task information: content-free blocks achieve substantial probe gains across all tested models (up to + 35.8 +35.8 on MiniCPM-o 4.5 and + 40.9 +40.9 on Qwen2.5-VL-32B). Blocking ℛ {\mathcal{R}} ’s access to the earlier context during prefill largely removes these gains, returning accuracy to within 4.6 points of the cue-only baseline (Appendix E ). The gains therefore primarily depend on input information written into ℛ {\mathcal{R}} , not on the block itself shifting the model’s option preferences. The effective block varies by model: on Qwen2.5-VL, white and yellow images yield near-zero gains, whereas noise yields + 21.1 +21.1 to + 33.4 +33.4 points; on MiniCPM-V/o 4.5 and Gemma-3-12B-IT, uniform images yield strong gains. One possible explanation is that Qwen2.5-VL maps a uniform image to identical visual tokens that are hard to perform computation on, whereas the other models add absolute position embeddings that keep these tokens distinct (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: Image blocks generally outperform text blocks. The best image block outperforms the best text block for five of six models, with an average margin of 7.0 points across all six (Table 3 ); among content-free blocks alone, the best one is also an image block for the same five models. Qwen2.5-VL-32B is the only exception, for which spaces work best. The block’s modality thus matters: the visual block is the more effective scratchpad.

Across the seven reasoning benchmarks, the white image improves scores over ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle by + 1.6 +1.6 points on MiniCPM-o 4.5 and + 0.9 +0.9 on Gemma-3-12B-IT, while Qwen2.5-VL-32B gains only + 0.1 +0.1 (Table 4 ). The replayed segments thus support contextual computation as well as another view of the same pixels.

blocks.en: Findings 1 and 2 show that the second look reorganizes visual information under question guidance and provides a prefill scratchpad. We next ask whether generated reasoning can replace these functions. In text-only models, reasoning may repeat the question and reduce the benefit of prompt repetition, as suggested by prior work ( Leviathan et al., 2025 ) . We compare direct-answer instructions with default benchmark prompts, which permit reasoning without requiring it. The text-only experiment compares ⟨ 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle and ⟨ 𝒯 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle on Qwen2.5-32B over five text benchmarks; the VLM experiment compares ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle and ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 , 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle on Qwen2.5-VL-32B over the 12 main benchmarks (per-benchmark results in Appendix G ).

blocks.en: Generated reasoning does not replace prefill replay. SLP improves the VLM average by 1.3 1.3 points with direct-answer instructions and 1.4 1.4 with default prompts (Table 5 ). The similar gains indicate that generated reasoning does not substitute for the unified encoding of visual and textual information established by replaying the pair during prefill in these settings; explicit reasoning-effort controls on Qwen3.8-27B ( low , medium , and xhigh , up to > 4,200 >4{,}200 output tokens) likewise retain consistent SLP gains of + 2.2 +2.2 to + 2.9 +2.9 points (Appendix K ). From the modality perspective, reasoning produces text, which may be a less effective scratchpad than visual tokens. This is consistent with the generally stronger image-block results in Finding 2, though that probe compares fixed input blocks rather than generated rationales (Section 3.3.2 ). Together, these differences suggest that input-side replay complements generation-time reasoning across tested reasoning budgets.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Prompt repetition and reasoning strategies. Reasoning strategies include CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Kojima et al., 2022 ) , self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , and structured search ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Besta et al., 2024 ) . Other work studies sensitivity to input order ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2024b ) and improves reasoning, embeddings, or sequence labeling by repeating the input ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Springer et al., 2025 ; Kukić et al., 2026 ) . Repetition gains vary by task ( Shaier et al., 2024 ) and can diminish when reasoning is permitted ( Leviathan et al., 2025 ) . We show that repeating an image–question pair establishes unified multimodal encoding, with gains that persist when reasoning is permitted.
blocks.zh: 迅速重复和推理策略。 合理策略包括CoT(Wei等人,2022年;Kojima等人,2022年),自我一致性(Wang等人,2023年),以及结构化搜索(姚等人,2023年;Besta等人,2024年). 其他工作研究对输入顺序的敏感性(Liu等人,2024a); Chen et al., 2024b),并通过重复输入来改进推理,嵌入,或序列标签(徐等人,2024;Springer等人,2025;Kukić等人,2026). 重复收益因任务而异(Shaier等人,2024年),在允许推理时可以减少(Leviathan等人,2025年)。 我们显示,重复一个图像-问题对建立统一的多式联运编码,在允许推理时,收益会持续。

blocks.en: Input order and cross-modal conditioning. Input order affects VLMs ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Wardle and Sušnjak, 2025 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . Architectural designs enable question-conditioned visual features ( Dai et al., 2023 ; Ganz et al., 2024 ) . Concurrent work studies ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 , 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle for visual steering and question access in natural-image VQA and compositional matching ( Abhinandan et al., 2026 ) . However, transfer to broader reasoning tasks and frontier proprietary VLMs remains untested. We evaluate SLP across 12 reasoning and perception benchmarks and 12 open-source and proprietary VLMs, and investigate how visual replay supports computation beyond re-exposure to the image.
blocks.zh: 输入顺序和跨模式调节. 输入令影响VLMs(Tan等人,2024年;Wardle和Sušnjak,2025年;Wei等人,2026年)。 建筑设计可以实现问题化的视觉特征(Dai等人,2023年;Ganz等人,2024年). 同时进行的工作研究有:⟨V,T,V,T\langle\ mathcal\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\Mathcal\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}},{\Mathcal\xcolor[rgb]{0,1,0,1}V}}},{\Mathcal\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}在自然影像VQA和成分匹配中用于视觉引导和质疑访问的T}}}\Rangle(Abhinandan等人,2026年). 然而,转移至更广泛的推理任务和前沿专有的甚高压材料仍未经过检验。 我们通过12个推理和感知基准以及12个开源和专有的VLM来评价SLP,并调查视觉重播如何支持计算,超越对图像的再曝光.

blocks.en: Reasoning with visual intermediates. Thinking-with-images methods interactively extract, crop, mark, or sketch images during reasoning ( Su et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024d ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) ; multimodal CoT produces rationales conditioned on both modalities ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Mitra et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) ; and VGR replays detected image regions during reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Unlike these generation-time methods, SLP operates on the input side.

blocks.en: Computation with additional tokens. Pause tokens ( Goyal et al., 2024 ) , filler tokens ( Pfau et al., 2024 ) , and vision-transformer registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) show how additional token positions can support computation, typically with training. SLP instead repeats the image–question pair to enable question-conditioned visual processing during prefill. Our analyses further show that the added visual tokens can serve as a scratchpad without additional training (Section 3.3.2 ).

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: SLP is a simple input-side intervention, and its scope and costs have three main limitations. First, duplicate images may interfere with position-sensitive tasks: in stress tests, counting and spatial relations hold ( − 0.12 -0.12 on CountQA; + 0.54 +0.54 on SpatialMQA), but grounding drops by 1.11 1.11 points on RefCOCOg (Appendix J ). Second, training on SLP takes 2.25 × 2.25\times the wall-clock time of standard training due to the duplicated prefix (32.0 vs. 14.2 hours for 5,000 steps on 16 A100 GPUs; Appendix H ). Third, SLP does not yet offer a unified treatment of multi-image or interleaved image–text inputs: our experiments are limited to prompts whose original form is ⟨ 𝒱 , 𝒯 ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}\rangle , and how to replay other input organizations is left for future work.
blocks.zh: SLP是一种简单的投入边干预,其范围和成本有三个主要局限性. 首先,重复图像可能会干扰对位置敏感的任务:在应力测试,计数和空间关系持有(QA伯爵为−0.12-0.12;空间MQA为+0.54+0.54),但在RefCOCOg(Appendix J)上落地1.11 1.11分. 第二,由于重复的前缀(32.0对14.2小时对16个A100GPU的5000步;附录H),SLP的训练需要2.25×2.25\时间进行标准训练. 第三, SLP 尚未对多图像或互映图像进行统一处理 — text 输入 : 我们的实验仅限于原始形式为 QQ V, T \ langle\ mathcal\\ xcolor [rgb]{0, 0, 1} V}}}, \ mathcal\ xcolor [rgb]{1, 0.5, 0} T}}}\rangle 的提示, 如何重放其他输入组织留待未来工作。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free input presentation that addresses the cross-modal partial-observation problem by establishing unified multimodal encoding under causal attention. SLP reshapes prefill computation: the repeated image revisits the earlier visual content under the question’s guidance, and the repeated question then conditions on the resulting visual states. These added visual tokens also act as a prefill scratchpad, retaining answer-relevant input information, so that even a blank second look can aid reasoning. SLP’s gains persist when reasoning is allowed, unlike those of text-only repetition. Continued training improves performance under SLP while retaining a similar average under standard prompting. These results position input-side prompting as an accessible control surface complementary to generation-time reasoning. They also suggest that the potential of input presentation remains underexplored and raise a broader question: what properties distinguish visual from textual tokens during prefill, and how do these differences shape the integration of the image and question?
blocks.zh: 我们采用 " 二次目光提示 " (SLP),这是一种免费培训输入介绍,通过在因果关注下建立统一的多式联运编码,解决跨模式部分观察问题。 SLP重塑了预填计算:重复的图像在问题的指导下重温了先前的视觉内容,重复的问题然后对由此产生的视觉状态附加条件. 这些添加的视觉符号还起到预填抓图的作用,保留了与答案相关的输入信息,这样即使是空白的第二外观也能帮助推理. 与只重复文本的做法不同, 继续培训提高了在标准激励下的业绩,同时保持了类似的平均数。 这些结果将输入侧作为辅助生成时间推理的无障碍控制表面。 他们也提出,投入展示的潜力仍然没有得到充分挖掘,并提出了一个更广泛的问题:在预填时,什么属性区分视觉和文字符号,这些差异如何塑造图像和问题的综合?

blocks.en: E.1 Protocol

blocks.en: We use the strict single-answer multiple-choice subsets of DynaMath, We-Math, MMBench, MMStar, and AI2D, sampling 128 questions per benchmark for each model (640 per model). The probe prefills ⟨ 𝒱 1 , 𝒯 1 , ℛ , “Answer:” ⟩ \langle{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}V}}}_{1},{\mathcal{{\color[rgb]{1,0.5,0}T}}}_{1},{\mathcal{R}},\text{``Answer:''}\rangle . blocks.en: In the scratchpad probe, white and yellow images yield at most + 2.2 +2.2 points on the three Qwen2.5-VL models but + 31.7 +31.7 to + 35.8 +35.8 points on MiniCPM-V/o 4.5 and Gemma-3-12B-IT (Table 3 ). One possible explanation lies in where positional information enters the vision encoder. Gemma-3-12B-IT and MiniCPM-V/o 4.5 use SigLIP-based encoders that add learned absolute position embeddings to the patch embeddings before the first Transformer layer, so even a uniform image yields visual tokens that differ across positions. 1 1 1 See the SigLIP embeddings , and the MiniCPM-V 4.5 resampler and configuration . MiniCPM’s 64 learned resampler queries alone would not produce this variation: the resampler adds position only to its keys, so identical encoder features would yield identical outputs for every query. Qwen2.5-VL’s vision encoder has no additive position embedding and injects position only through rotary embeddings on queries and keys. 2 2 2 See the Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder . Rotary embeddings change attention weights but not the values being averaged, so identical patches remain identical through the encoder and the patch merger, and a uniform image enters the decoder as repeated copies of a single vector. Noise images, whose visual tokens are distinct, are effective on Qwen2.5-VL (Table 3 ), consistent with this account. The analysis concerns image blocks only; text blocks follow a different embedding and position path and may behave differently. Testing whether identical visual tokens cause the near-zero gains requires measuring and intervening on visual-token states.

blocks.en: SLP presents the image as two separate visual-token blocks, which could lead a model to count instances once per copy, confuse spatial relations across copies, or emit less reliable box coordinates.
